pages.text: “Fragrant and elegant, its hidden power flows quietly.”$(br2)Jasmine Tea is a delicate and refreshing beverage made from dried jasmine flowers and sugar. Drinking it provides a temporary Invisibility and Luck effect, making travelers more mysterious and fortunate.
$(br2)$(br)To prepare Jasmine Tea, $(br)boil dried jasmine flowers with sugar.$(br)It is best consumed before stealth missions or important actions, offering a veil of secrecy and fortune.

Upon drinking Jasmine Tea, travelers gain a temporary Invisibility and Luck effect, making their actions more discreet and rewarding.$(br)This tea is ideal for covert operations.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
